content.text:
Three structural changes:

- **`Sorter` interface** declares the generic `sort` contract — any future sorting strategy just implements this one method.
- **`QuickSorter implements Sorter`** — the `@Override` annotation makes the relationship explicit; all internals (`quickSort`, `partition`, `swap`) stay private.
- **`main` declares `Sorter sorter`** — the variable is typed to the interface, so swapping in a different implementation (e.g. `MergeSorter`) requires changing only the constructor call.
